hero.description: NEXUS AI connects your agency's projects, customer support, and finances to create a single, explainable, and actionable view of your business.

healthEngine.title: Enterprise Health Engine
healthEngine.subtitle: Consolidated view of the company
healthEngine.insightText: Project risk is currently the dominant factor. SHAP analysis notably identifies an under-staffed team.

product.description: NEXUS AI avoids treating each problem separately. Operational, customer, and financial signals are connected to provide a global view of the business.

ai.description: Each model specializes in a specific business problem, then their results are merged by the Enterprise Health Engine.

modules.title: Project risk
modules.subtitle: Anticipate before it happens
modules.description: NEXUS AI estimates the effort required for a project and identifies factors likely to cause an overrun.

modules.title: Smart support
modules.subtitle: Prioritize what matters
modules.description: Every customer ticket is automatically analyzed by category, urgency, and expressed sentiment.

modules.title: Financial health
modules.subtitle: Understand weak signals
modules.description: Financial data is converted into ratios and analyzed to identify signs of distress.

ai.groqTitle: Generative AI, but never to make up the numbers.
ai.groqText: Scores and predictions are computed by trained models or by Laravel. Groq is used only to rephrase results in natural language.

method.description: A simple journey: centralize, analyze, understand, then act.

steps.title: Centralize
steps.description: Projects, tickets, and financial data are brought together in a single platform.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.description: Three specialized AI models study each dimension independently.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: Results are explained through the most important factors.

steps.title: Decide
steps.description: The system turns analyses into alerts and recommendations.

roles.description: Each role has an experience tailored to its operational needs.

security.description: NEXUS AI assists human decision-making. It does not blindly replace the team's judgment.

items.title: Strict permissions
items.text: Accounts are created by invitation only.

items.title: Human validation
items.text: Critical decisions remain under human control.

cta.description: A platform designed to turn the complex data of digital agencies into understandable decisions.
